# LaTeX Viewer

> A free online LaTeX editor with a live PDF preview. Write or import .tex files, compile them with Tectonic, jump to errors, and copy clean text or Markdown.

LaTeX Viewer helps students, researchers, engineers, and technical writers preview LaTeX documents without installing a TeX distribution. It compiles LaTeX source to PDF on the server with Tectonic and shows compiler errors on the line that caused them.

## Primary URL

- https://latex-viewer-alpha.vercel.app/

## Best For

- Editing and previewing LaTeX documents online.
- Compiling .tex files to PDF from a browser.
- Checking equations, sections, and document formatting quickly.
- Extracting clean plain text or Markdown from LaTeX source.

## Key Features

- Code editor with LaTeX highlighting, autocomplete, and search.
- Live PDF preview with selectable text, clickable links, and zoom.
- Compiler errors underlined in the editor with the full log on demand.
- Content-based build caching for instant undo and repeat compiles.
- Plain text and Markdown views with one-click copy.
- Command palette, keyboard shortcuts, light and dark themes, and a phone layout.

## API

- POST /api/compile with a JSON body { "source": "<LaTeX>" } returns the compiled PDF, or JSON with "error" and "log" when compilation fails.

## Repository

- https://github.com/yesabhishek/latex-viewer
